label: Late original-phase steps (t>=4) and <DEL> in sequences that start with f
explanation: Fires almost only in sequences whose first original token is f (91% of activation mass; 25.8x lift). Within those, it fires on original-phase steps at t>=4 (peak t=5-6) and somewhat on the <DEL> step. It never fires at t<3 or in the copy phase. Magnitude is higher when q, x or s show up early in the prefix (e.g. f q q x ..., f ? q x ...; prev2_tok q/x has 4.5-4.8x lift) and on first occurrences of a token. Precision is low (~0.11): most f-initial late-prefix steps stay inactive. Content-based refinements (q/x/s seen earlier) raise precision to ~0.33 but cut recall a lot, so which f-sequences activate depends on a diffuse mix of tokens that is not fully captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=f (+8.36), orig2=q (+4.27), prev_tok=x (+3.69), orig3=q (+3.34), orig1=q (+3.14), orig0=n (+2.89). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-8.03), phase=2 (-6.72), prev3_tok=k (-3.35), orig2=r (-3.26).
